question: The Indian Council of Arbitration (ICA) convened a Symposium-cum-Roundtable on 'Bridging Markets, Resolving Disputes via ADR in the India–Singapore Corridor' during which event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore Convention Week 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Council of Arbitration (ICA)**, in collaboration with **FICCI**, organized a significant **Symposium-cum-Roundtable** titled 'Bridging Markets, Resolving Disputes via ADR in the India–Singapore Corridor'.
 
• This event was held on the sidelines of the **Singapore Convention Week 2025**, which is a premier global event dedicated to **dispute resolution**. *Hence, the correct answer is Singapore Convention Week 2025.*
 
• The primary objective of the symposium was to discuss and enhance the use of **Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR)** mechanisms to facilitate smoother trade and investment between **India** and **Singapore**.
